questions.question_text: What documentation is required to support a claim for sports quota eligibility?
options: A letter from a gym trainer
Certified sports certificates from recognized Boards or National Federations
A receipt for sports equipment
A screenshot of a video game high score
questions.explanation: Official documentation is required to prove participation at competitive levels, such as Inter-Board or National level sports.

questions.question_text: What is typically assessed during a sports trial for team sports?
options: Mathematical calculation skills
Physical agility, technical skill, and teamwork capacity
The candidate's ability to recite poetry
Knowledge of university financial accounts
questions.explanation: Sports trials are designed to evaluate the practical athletic ability and tactical awareness required for university-level team representation.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is considered a valid proof of a co-curricular achievement?
options: A verbal promise from a coach
An attested certificate from a recognized authority/organizer
A photo posted on social media
A written note from a friend
questions.explanation: Only verified documentation carries weight in the admission process to ensure credibility of achievements.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of the sports trial at GCU?
options: To promote professional sports leagues
To identify students with athletic talent for the university's representative teams
To force all students to exercise
To sell athletic merchandise
questions.explanation: Sports trials are conducted to scout and recruit talent to represent the university in inter-collegiate and national competitions.

questions.question_text: During a sports trial for individual sports (e.g., Badminton or Athletics), what is typically measured?
options: The candidate's ability to lead a team
Physical stamina, technique, and speed
The candidate's knowledge of the history of the sport
The candidate's fashion sense
questions.explanation: Individual sports trials focus on physiological performance metrics and the technical execution of the sport's core movements.

questions.question_text: How is a candidate's 'Co-Curricular' record used in the admission process?
options: It is used as a substitute for academic grades
It may be used as a tie-breaker for candidates with similar academic scores
It is completely irrelevant to the admission office
It is only considered for students who failed the entrance test
questions.explanation: Co-curricular achievements highlight a student's dedication outside of the classroom, often providing a decisive advantage in merit-based selection.

questions.question_text: What is an essential requirement for a student participating in GCU sports trials?
options: Bringing professional agents to the trial
Possessing valid medical clearance/fitness for physical exertion
Prior membership in a professional league
Wearing a university uniform
questions.explanation: Safety is paramount; candidates must demonstrate they are physically fit to participate to prevent injuries during the trial.

questions.question_text: Which factor is prioritized during a sports trial for a team sport like Cricket or Football?
options: Solo performance only
Game sense, coordination, and ability to follow team strategy
The candidate's height and weight
Knowledge of sports history
questions.explanation: Team sports prioritize the ability to collaborate effectively within a group dynamic under pressure.

questions.question_text: What is considered a 'certified' co-curricular achievement for admission weightage?
options: A verbal reference from a school peer
An official certificate signed by a recognized authority or organization
A photograph of the event uploaded to social media
An unverified mention in a personal statement
questions.explanation: Institutional weightage requires verifiable documentation to ensure fairness and authenticity.

questions.question_text: Why do sports trials for individual events (like 100m sprint) involve objective metrics?
options: To make the process easier for organizers
To provide a precise, undeniable performance benchmark
Because personal traits don't matter in athletics
To keep the trials short
questions.explanation: Individual sports performance relies on quantifiable metrics like time or distance to rank candidates objectively.

questions.question_text: What does a 'Sports Trial' typically test in a team player like a footballer?
options: Only theoretical knowledge of the rules
Individual skill, teamwork, tactical awareness, and physical fitness
Height and weight measurements only
Academic record in sports management
questions.explanation: Team sports require evaluating how an individual performs within a coordinated group dynamic.

questions.question_text: Which of these is the most preferred document to verify a co-curricular achievement?
options: A handwritten letter from a friend
A verbal testimony of a teacher
A signed and stamped participation certificate from an recognized institution
A social media post confirming the event
questions.explanation: Official authentication is required to validate the authenticity of extra-curricular accomplishments.

questions.question_text: For an individual event like a 100m sprint, why are trials highly competitive?
options: Because there are no other criteria for admission
Because the objective metrics (time) clearly distinguish the top candidates
Because physical size is the only factor
Because it is the only sport offered at GCU
questions.explanation: In individual sports, time or distance provide an undeniable metric for performance merit.

questions.question_text: What is the primary role of the 'Sports Committee' during the admission phase?
options: To provide financial aid to all applicants
To evaluate and rank candidates based on physical performance and verified achievements
To organize the convocation ceremony
To act as admission tutors for the entry test
questions.explanation: The committee is tasked with identifying athletes who will represent the university at inter-collegiate levels.

questions.question_text: If a student claims national-level achievement, what is the standard procedure?
options: The committee takes the claim at face value
The candidate must present the medal and the official letter from the relevant sports federation
The candidate must play a game against a professional
The candidate is automatically enrolled
questions.explanation: Claims of national standing must be backed by official sports governing bodies for the merit points to be awarded.
